briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch escalates AGI race as compute leaders race to 100k H100 clusters

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Multi-agent systems dominate deployment conversations as security gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with 4x reasoning gains; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind ships Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI trains Colossus 2 cluster; DeepSeek V4 hits top benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and CoreWeave announce 200k GPU expansions; TSMC ramps 3nm AI chips; Saudi sovereign fund commits $6B to regional AI data centers amid energy constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 100k-agent swarm deployment trigger mandatory international oversight by Q2 2027?
